# Opening models

Open <code>N3</code> → <code>N3 → File</code> and choose <code>N3 → File → Open…</code> to open an N3 document (`.n3.json`) or import an OBJ
file. Importing an OBJ starts an untitled document with editable mesh objects;
save it as an N3 document to keep your edits. A successful open fits the model
into the viewport automatically. The current document remains visible while
you choose a file; opening a file replaces it and updates the geometry counts.

This example shows **bracket.obj**, with **12
vertices**, **8 polygon faces**, and
**20 display triangles**. Polygon faces may become
multiple triangles for drawing, so these counts can differ.

If the source model uses Z as its vertical axis, enable <code>Preferences → Z-up</code> in Preferences.
This changes its displayed orientation without changing the document geometry.
Turn it off to return to the initial orientation. Continue with
[moving around](navigation.md) to explore the model from other angles.
